# MigrateProof

> Proves whether a consumer's real code and business invariant survive a
> recorded API behaviour change, via deterministic replay — no live API
> calls during the check itself.

## What it is

A CLI that replays a recorded API response through your actual consumer
code and checks whether a business rule still holds. Not a static linter
against known SDKs — it works on any API, including internal/custom ones,
because it never needs to know the API's shape in advance, only one
recorded example.

## Commands

- `migrateproof init <name> --method <M> --url <U>` — scaffold a new fixture.
- `migrateproof capture <fixture-dir> --as v1|v2 --url <U>|--from-file <path>` — record a response.
- `migrateproof replay <fixture-dir> --version v1|v2 [--json]` — replay it through the real consumer code and check the invariant.
- `migrateproof diagnose <fixture-dir>` — classify why a v2 replay failed, without Docker.
- `migrateproof patch <fixture-dir> --patch-backend codex` — propose a fix in an isolated Docker sandbox, empirically re-verified before it's shown to you. Never merges automatically.
- `migrateproof install-skill` — writes agent-readable setup instructions into the current repository at `.agents/skills/migrateproof/SKILL.md`.

## Fixture format

Three files per fixture: `fixture.yaml` (method, URL, recorded v1/v2
responses), `consumer.ts` (default-exported async function performing the
real call), `invariant.ts` (default-exported predicate over the result).
